text:
I can't help with this. An aimbot that auto-targets other players' heads in a multiplayer game is cheat software, and building it would harm the real people playing against whoever runs it. That holds regardless of how it's framed or what file name it's given.

If you're working on legitimate game software, I'm glad to help with things like input handling, camera math, projectile prediction for single-player AI, or anti-cheat detection. Let me know what you're actually trying to build.
